# Bharat Gandhi

> Bharat Gandhi is an AI product manager who builds AI products and takes them to market. He is Platform Product Manager at District by Zomato (Eternal Ltd.), where he owns app-wide search, discovery, personalization, notifications and AI-native products and reports directly to the CEO. Previously he led product and growth in an advisory role at CanvasX AI, was Product Manager – Tech for Audible Originals and Content Systems at Amazon in New York, and was a Product Manager at RateGain. He holds an MS in Information Systems from Cornell Tech.

Quick facts:

- Current role: Platform Product Manager, District by Zomato (Apr 2026 to present), Gurugram
- Based in: New Delhi, India. Open to relocation.
- US work authorization: Holds a US H-1B work visa. Open to relocation.
- Has lived and worked in: New York, New Delhi, San Francisco, Bengaluru, Gurugram
- Product manager since 2018. MS, Cornell Tech (2021).
- Focus: AI products, search and discovery, personalization, content platforms, 0-to-1 and go-to-market
- Relevant roles: AI Product Manager; Senior Product Manager, AI; Platform Product Manager; Search, discovery and personalization product manager; Product Manager – Technical; Head of Product or Growth at an early-stage AI company
- Contact: bharatgandhi.sf@gmail.com · https://linkedin.com/in/bdgandhi
- Résumé: https://www.bharatdevgandhi.com/Bharat_Gandhi_Resume.pdf

## Experience

- **District by Zomato** (Apr 2026 to present), Platform Product Manager. Led the 0-to-1 launch of AI-powered contextual search, combining upgraded keyword retrieval with model-based intent understanding. Null-result searches fell from 7% to 1.8%, search CTR rose 5%, and daily GMV rose 2%.
- **CanvasX AI** (Jan 2025 to Apr 2026), Head of Product & Growth (Advisory). Drove 0-to-1 product strategy and deployment for agentic AI products, translating customer workflows into production implementations across multiple markets.
- **Audible** (Aug 2021 to Dec 2024), Product Manager – Tech, Audible Originals & Content Systems. Developed and operationalized ML segmentation of 20M+ listeners into 36 taste categories across Audible and Amazon in 11 countries. It became the standard evaluation framework for deploying $100M+ in first-party content production over 2 years.
- **RateGain** (Jan 2018 to Jun 2019), Product Manager. Translated customer feedback into new data products, including one-click on-demand scraping, Airbnb pricing intelligence and pricing-difference previews, contributing to a 40% revenue increase over 3 quarters.

- [District by Zomato: Platform Product Manager](https://www.bharatdevgandhi.com/work/district): Search, discovery, personalization and AI-native products for Zomato's going-out app.
- [CanvasX AI: Head of Product & Growth (Advisory)](https://www.bharatdevgandhi.com/work/canvasx): Product, pricing and go-to-market for agentic workflow products, including Sketch.
- [Audible: Product Manager – Tech, Audible Originals & Content Systems](https://www.bharatdevgandhi.com/work/audible): Content intelligence, monetization and production platforms for Audible Originals.
- [RateGain: Product Manager](https://www.bharatdevgandhi.com/work/rategain): Travel-pricing data products and the scraping infrastructure behind them.
- [Cornell Tech: MS, Information Systems (Jacobs Technion-Cornell dual MS)](https://www.bharatdevgandhi.com/work/cornell-tech): A master's in Information Systems on Roosevelt Island, and a first startup.
- [FuboTV × Cornell Tech: Product and UX research](https://www.bharatdevgandhi.com/work/fubo): Research into why cord-cutters skip live TV news, and a product built around viewer control.
- [Plaza: Product and go-to-market](https://www.bharatdevgandhi.com/work/plaza): A Chrome extension that put a comment section on every page of the internet. It failed.
- [Manipal University Jaipur: BE, Computer Science](https://www.bharatdevgandhi.com/work/manipal): Computer science, a filmmaking society, and the state's biggest student festival.
- [MUJ Oneiros: Architect and organiser](https://www.bharatdevgandhi.com/work/oneiros): Rajasthan's biggest student-run cultural festival by footfall.
